# ShowMyPhoto — Full Product Information

## Overview

ShowMyPhoto is an AI-powered event photo-sharing platform designed for photographers. It helps photographers publish event galleries and gives guests faster ways to find and receive photos.

## Guest experience

Guests can access an event gallery through a QR code or shared link. Depending on the event configuration, guests can use selfie search or AI face recognition to locate photos in which they appear.

## Photographer workflow

Photographers can upload event photos, organize them into event galleries, control downloads and photo selection, and share the gallery with guests.

## Delivery

ShowMyPhoto supports photo delivery workflows that can include WhatsApp and email.

## Key features

- AI face recognition
- Selfie search
- QR-code photo sharing
- Event photo galleries
- Branded galleries
- Photo selection
- Download permissions and controls
- WhatsApp delivery
- Email delivery

## Typical use cases

- Weddings
- Corporate events
- Parties
- Conferences
- School events
- Sports events
- Other high-volume event photography
